description:
Use this when you need a deterministic Kazakhstan Kazakhstan nationwide published 2026 five-day public-holiday and transfer schedule result. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when this package covers the nationwide published 2026 five-day schedule over a Saturday-Sunday baseline. Six-day, shift, continuous-operation, employer, bank, school, local and sector calendars are not inferred. Qurban Ait is represented by the published 2026 first-day date. Adilet's current text records Constitution Day on 15 March with an amendment effective 2026-07-01, while the published 2026 government calendar does not add a March 15/16 closure; this package follows the published 2026 calendar and future-year packages must refresh the legal transition.
What it computes: Checks a date against the Saturday-Sunday weekend baseline and exact 2026-2026 authority events.
Example user requests: Kazakhstan: Nauryz transfer day. | Kazakhstan: Ordinary weekday.
Inputs: date (date).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"date":"2026-03-24"} | {"date":"2026-09-14"}
Outputs: territory, territory_name, weekday, is_working_day, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, holiday_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: is_working_day = not an official Saturday/Sunday weekend date and no exact authority event
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/kazakhstan-public-working-day with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/kazakhstan-public-working-day.md

date.description: Gregorian date in Kazakhstan's pinned 2026 nationwide published five-day schedule.

name: check_kz_working_day

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: Kazakhstan nationwide published 2026 five-day public-holiday and transfer schedule

day_type.description: Deterministic classification: official_weekend, regular_workday, or the first published authority event kind.

holiday_details.description: Structured event details, including partial-day notes where published.

is_working_day.description: Monday-Friday with no event in this pinned authority scope.

substitute_day_policy.description: Only published 2026 transfer dates are included; no future, employer or unscheduled transfer is inferred

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Kazakhstan Working Day
